classification.difficultyReason: Identify side roles in differently oriented right triangles and choose the appropriate trigonometric ratio. The hardest parts require rearranging a ratio with the unknown in the denominator; angle parts use routine inverse functions. All givens are explicit, with no auxiliary construction or unfamiliar connection required.
